title: I never leave things halfway.
description: Full-circle or nothing. I believe work isn’t 'done' until it feels done — refined, complete, and intuitive.

title: I take ownership — fully.
description: On two separate projects I was the only developer, no safety net. I scoped, built, shipped, and owned the outcome from start to finish.

title: I naturally think like a user.
description: I don’t just test for bugs — I test for hesitation, confusion, and delight. Real insights come from real empathy.

title: I adapt with clarity.
description: Plan changes don’t throw me off — they energize me. I stay flexible, grounded, and focused.

title: I think in data flows, not just UI states.
description: Before I build a component, I ask: where does this data come from, how should it be shaped, and what happens when it changes? The UI is the last step.

title: I build the integration layer, not just the screen.
description: REST APIs, auth flows, real-time subscriptions, payment pipelines — I design and wire them together, then build the interface on top.
